company.shortDescription: Addenda is a blockchain-based insurtech startup that uses the blockchain to share insurance information.
company.description: Addenda is a blockchain-based insurtech startup that uses the blockchain to share insurance information. The company is based in Dubai, UAE. Addenda is an AI-powered SaaS platform that helps businesses digitize and automate operational workflows. It provides modular solutions for industries like insurance, automotive, healthcare, and facility management, focusing on areas such as claims processing, vehicle inspections, appointment scheduling, and workflow automation. The platform uses AI to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and speed up business operations.
